newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Hope Group to slash feed grain prices.
newsitem.headline: China's Hope Group to slash feed grain prices.

text.p: The Hope Group, China's biggest privately-owned company, has announced it will slash the price of its fodder by an average of 350 yuan a tonne in east China as of Saturday, the Xinhua news agency reported.

The agency said that one of the main reasons for the Hope Group's move was an earlier announcement by another feed-processing giant, Shanghai Dajiang, that it would cut its prices by four to 15 percent.
Another factor was that China had good harvests last year, which brought down both grain prices and plant costs in feed production, it said.
Hope is one of the country's feed-processing giants and sold 4.5 billion yuan worth of feed products last year, the agency said.
